title: VCAP Negotiation Response
description: Sent by the provider to accept, reject, or counter a negotiation request.

message_type.description: Discriminator for the VCAP message type.

negotiation_id.description: Must match the negotiation_id from the corresponding negotiation_request.

counter_terms.description: OPTIONAL counter-offer terms. Present when response_status is COUNTERED or REJECTED.

amount.description: Counter-offer price in decimal currency units.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the counter-offer.

description.description: Modified scope description for the counter-offer.

deadline_utc.description: Revised ISO 8601 deadline proposed by the provider.

rejection_reason.description: Human-readable reason for rejection. Present when response_status is REJECTED.

provider_verification_hints.description: OPTIONAL hints from the provider about how to verify their delivery.

url.description: URL the provider expects the verifier to check.
